description: Connects a device's interface to a subnet (with IP; optionally creates an IO-system). CPU and IO-devices MUST be on the SAME subnet. The result carries a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads the connection after the write); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches): re-read with tia_device_network before retrying. Maps to POST /network/connect. M-off.

createIoSystem.description: create an IO-system on this connection

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

name: tia_network_connect
title: TIA — connect to subnet
